reuse.why: It extends the existing getBulkBudgetCategories and getBudgetData queries, but does not use getBulkBudgetCategories as the place to exclude categories, which is what it already does for hidden and goal categories.

duplication.why: The same `if (isFixedGroup(...)) skip` guard is pasted into six action loops and the notes join is added to two queries.

placement.why: The predicate sits in budget/actions.ts next to the selection queries, but the exclusion is applied in each action instead of in the shared category selection that already filters the other excluded categories.

scope.why: Only the budget action module and one test are touched.

maintainability.why: Readable, but a new month-wide action must remember to add the guard, and the rule is applied in six places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: budget/actions.ts: getBulkBudgetCategories already decides which categories bulk actions touch (WHERE hidden/goal_def), yet the fixed-group exclusion is done in each caller loop (setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3/6/12MonthAvg) instead.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated guard is a literal copy in each loop, not reshaped.

one_place.where: The #fixed test is one function (isFixedGroup), but deciding to skip is repeated in copyPreviousMonth, setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg; the tag lookup join is added separately to getBulkBudgetCategories and getBudgetData.
